name: GPU Marching Cubes Terrain Pipeline with Indirect Rendering
aliases: GPU Marching Cubes with Indirect Rendering
definition: A GPU-accelerated pipeline that extracts an implicit terrain surface from voxel data using Marching Cubes, manages multiple LOD levels, and renders generated triangles via indirect draw calls to minimize CPU-GPU synchronization overhead.
summary: This GPU pipeline extracts terrain surfaces from voxel data via Marching Cubes and renders them using indirect draw calls, eliminating CPU-GPU synchronization stalls by keeping all draw argument generation on the GPU.
